title: fhirviews: FHIR desde R y vistas tabulares con SQL on FHIR
description: Development 0.5.0.9001, not a CRAN release and not assigned a version DOI yet. R client for FHIR R4 servers and SQL on FHIR view engine. Includes eight catalogue views, including AllergyIntolerance, and explicit SQL/table mappings to Patient, Observation, Encounter, Condition and Immunization. JSON/NDJSON output preserves decimal precision. R4 structural checks require separate clinical profile validation. A Rust validation laboratory is included in the repository, outside the R package; no native Rust engine or R4/R6 conversion is enabled. The earlier 0.5.0.9000 source archive has its own DOI.
